dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Wait. There's some filth staining my blade.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: We should properly maintain our weapons and rest adequately to prepare for the upcoming battle.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: A sharp weapon and a sharp mind are both indispensable.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: It seems like our many enemies lurk in the shadows.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: There is no cause for concern. Conserve your strength and focus on taking down their ringleader.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: A skulking beast is unfit to walk a hall as beautiful as this.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: The tea here is most fragrant. Perhaps you could pass along my regards to the owner of this space.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah... Judging by your expression, perhaps that request isn't as simple as it seems. Excuse me if it puts you in a difficult position.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: In any case, with its exceptional tea, incredible rooms, and slumbering secrets... It seems as if I've stumbled upon an interesting place indeed.
